summary: Three items cleared the bar. The most consequential development is operational rather than analytical: Open Research Europe is now available to all researchers at German institutions.
signal: The week connects three layers often treated separately: a publicly financed publishing alternative, controls on publication expenditure, and assessment practices that determine whether alternative outputs receive credit. Open Research Europe supplies infrastructure, but the NIH evidence and the OpenAIRE-DORA discussion show why infrastructure alone will not displace prestige-driven publication choices.
